name: guardian-angel
description: Guardian Angel — plateforme catholique : églises de Paris, missel, journal spirituel, missions paroissiales, passeport des églises.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-guardian --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.spec.mjs tests/notify.spec.mjs"
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p public/vendor/leaflet && cp -r node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css node_modules/leaflet/dist/images node_modules/leaflet/LICENSE public/vendor/leaflet/
scripts.emulators: npm run vendor && firebase emulators:start --project demo-guardian
scripts.deploy: npm run vendor && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
